items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: that name is familiar now... I never did word with going around him too much because he wasn't playing that regular.

ctx.x: You remember another old time drummer, Zeno, Henry Zeno. Henry Zeno.

Yeah, now wait now, that name is familiar now, Henry Zeno. I'm trying to think who I used to hear him play with. Henry Zeno. Oh, I just can't come back to him now. In fact, I never did word with going around him too much because he wasn't playing that regular.
Yeah, and you weren't a drummer at that time hardly I guess. No, no. He must have quit pretty early.
